## Relevant Learning Standards

21. Apply two-sample tests of difference and accurately interpret results in terms of hypothesis testing, statistical significance, and the direction and magnitude of any differences. 
22. Construct contingency tables and apply chi-square tests to assess association between categorical variables, interpreting results in terms of significance and practical meaning. 
:::
